image_description: A dorsal view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a reddish-purple rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping brownish-tan calcareous plates surrounded by a pinkish-purple leathery girdle with white spots. The background rock is textured and covered with small orange encrusting organisms. A cyan watermark text 'WWW.NATUREDIVER.COM ©' is visible at the bottom.
